card.name: Nouns before a quoted or glossed term
card.fires_on: A noun or opening bracket right before a quoted word, foreign term, or code-like name that the sentence is about to introduce. Seen in technical or explanatory web text, not in drug labels.

modes.label: Noun before a named item
modes.description: A general noun such as user, object, variable or measurements that is followed by a specific name or symbol.
modes.example: The file above belongs to the<< user>> "john" and the group "staff

modes.label: Opening bracket or quote for a gloss
modes.description: An opening parenthesis or quote mark that introduces a foreign term or translation.

card.writes: It makes an opening parenthesis or bracket with code-like characters more likely next, and it makes ordinary word continuations less likely.
card.plain: It fires on a plain noun that is about to be followed by a quoted name or a bracketed translation.
